blocks.imageAlt: Visual and material research during the creative process

items.title: Spatial diagnosis and strategy
items.summary: Before designing, we analyse your brand, business and spatial needs to set a strategy that brings everything together.

children.text: We identify commercial challenges and growth goals.
We assess whether the premises can support your business model.

items.title: Creative concept
items.summary: We turn strategy into a memorable spatial experience, shaping the customer journey and visual atmosphere to give your business a distinctive identity.

children.text: We bring your brand and values into the interior architecture.
We plan operations, the customer journey and key zones.
We develop furniture, lighting and material selections.
High-fidelity visualisations help you review and approve the space.

items.title: Technical development
items.summary: We turn the creative vision into a coherent, buildable project with the technical documentation needed to bring it to life.

children.text: Detailed plans for contractors and trades.
A cost breakdown for materials, furniture and trades.
We adapt the project to the premises’ technical and regulatory requirements.

items.title: Site supervision and installation coordination
items.summary: We guide delivery so the finished space stays true to the design, resolving issues and coordinating installation.

children.text: We coordinate communication between your needs and the technical team.
Regular visits check technical details and finishes.
We verify quality and that the result reflects your brand vision.
You can commission the process in phases and choose the level of support you need:
A focused two-hour session, followed by a report within 72 hours. We assess your premises and provide strategic guidance on integrating your brand, optimizing the space, and improving customer flow.
We develop the spatial concept and brand expression, and select furnishings, lighting, and custom pieces, with no or minimal changes to the existing layout and little to no construction.
360° support from the initial idea through to opening. We cover the process from strategy to delivery, including any layout changes and construction needed.
FAQ

items.title: When is the best time to contact the studio?
items.summary: The earlier we learn about your project, the better. We can join while you are shaping the business or considering a space, and also help rethink or improve an existing location.

children.text: Early decisions help identify opportunities and avoid later issues with layout, cost or delivery.

items.title: Do you work outside your city?
items.summary: Yes. Diagnosis and Creative Concept can be delivered in a hybrid format, combining online work with in-person visits. We travel for initial surveys and key delivery and installation stages.

items.title: Do you handle construction, permits and structural architecture?
items.summary: Our focus is spatial strategy and interior design.

children.text: For construction, permits and technical work requiring architects or engineers, we work with your own specialists or connect you with trusted professionals, coordinating the work so every part moves in the same direction.

items.title: What does site supervision include?
items.summary: We oversee the interior design delivery: checking placement, defining finishes and construction details, and coordinating materials and furniture installation so the result matches the design.

children.text: The construction company and/or appointed technical professional remains responsible for the technical and legal direction of the works.

items.title: How are project fees calculated?
items.summary: Fees depend on the project scope, complexity and specific needs.

children.text: Before work begins, you receive a detailed proposal setting out the scope and fees. You also receive a progress email every Friday, whether or not we met that week.

items.title: Do you work with your own builder, or can I choose my trades?
items.summary: We work with a trusted network, especially for bespoke joinery, metalwork, lighting and furniture.

children.text: If you already have a builder or trusted trades, we can coordinate with them and work together toward a successful result.

items.title: Can I buy my own materials?
items.summary: Coordinating purchases helps us anticipate issues, align deliveries with the build and reduce errors, delays and unexpected costs. We can also incorporate suppliers or materials you have already identified.

children.text: We mainly work with national suppliers we know and recommend according to each project’s needs and budget.
